prompt: After 200 turns, a support conversation hits the context limit and the bot forgets the customer's issue.
why: Summarize older turns into a compact recap and keep recent ones verbatim.
trap: Notes help agents; compaction is the window's own cleanup.

prompt: An agent's context is 70% old tool results: full file listings and logs it already acted on.
why: Clear or summarize stale tool output.
trap: Those results did their job; keeping them costs attention.

prompt: Auto-summaries keep losing the exact error message the user is debugging.
why: Tune the compaction prompt to preserve key details (errors, decisions, file names) verbatim.
trap: Compaction is right; what it keeps needs tuning.

prompt: A long agent session gets sloppier near the end even though it never hit the hard limit.
why: Quality degrades as context grows; compact before you reach the limit.
trap: Fitting in the window isn't the same as working well.
